title: The Man Who Bought a Bank for $1
sources: BBC On This Day, 26 February 1995: Barings Bank collapses after 1.4 billion dollar rogue trading losses
The Guardian: How Nick Leeson brought down Britain's oldest merchant bank, founded in 1762
Bank of England: Dutch financial institution ING takes over Barings Bank for 1 pound token payment

lines.text: In 1995, a man bought an entire two-hundred-year-old bank
lines.caps: In 1995 | a man bought | an entire bank

lines.text: Barings was Queen Elizabeth's personal bank,
lines.caps: Barings was | the Queen's | personal bank,

lines.text: and had funded world empires for centuries.
lines.caps: and had funded | world empires | for centuries.

lines.text: Until a twenty-eight-year-old trader in Singapore
secretly gambled on the Japanese stock market,
lines.caps: secretly | gambled | on the stock market,

lines.text: and lost over a billion dollars.
lines.caps: and lost | OVER A BILLION | dollars.

lines.text: The oldest bank in Britain collapsed overnight.
Panicked regulators scrambled for a buyer,
lines.caps: Panicked regulators | scrambled | for a buyer,

lines.text: until a Dutch banker offered to take everything,
lines.caps: until a banker | offered | to take everything,

lines.text: for the price of a single chocolate bar.
lines.caps: for the price of | a chocolate bar.

lines.text: He walked away owning the royal bank
lines.caps: He walked away | owning | the royal bank
